about: Detrusitol (tolterodine, a bladder antimuscarinic) is supplied every 4 weeks from December 2025 while the record holds a Dementia (Alzheimer type) condition line.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about dementia or the person's memory or thinking, while oxybutynin (a bladder antimuscarinic) is supplied every 4 weeks.
Vesicare (solifenacin) is supplied every 4 weeks, and the clinical assessment documents no dementia or chronic cognitive impairment.
